message.content:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Data Analyst position at your mid-sized logistics company. With four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn, I built a customer churn model that cut false‑positive alerts by 18 % over six months and led a team of three to deliver it. I understand the role calls for SQL and dashboard experience; I have used SQL occasionally, and while I have not yet built dashboards, I am eager to develop that skill set within your organization.
